rules.statement: The OB candidate candle itself works with/sweeps liquidity; a later unrelated raid cannot retroactively manufacture the OB candle.
After the liquidity-sweeping candle there is an aggressive impulsive candle that overlaps/engulfs the prior candle.
OB formation requires additional structural confirmation via BOS / movement change.
The OB formation must be located in a higher-timeframe POI. Stage 4 consumes a source-valid POI parent; it does not invent a new POI detector.
OB is inside the structural impulse and is worked with the current structural trend/update.
OB zone is the whole engulfed candidate candle including wicks.
First OB test is preferred in about 90% of cases; repeated entry may be considered after LTF reaction. This does not erase or create the historical OB object.

Методичка defines OB as the last candle before imbalance/sharp impulse, while SW9 says the signal is most accurate when IMB appears and warns not to ignore IMB. Presence of IMB is compatible with all sources; absence is not promoted to PASS or FAIL in the clean object layer until the conflict is formally resolved.
Breaker is a previously valid Order Block later broken by impulsive movement; it must preserve the parent OB identity.
The OB is broken by a fast whole/continuous impulsive movement without trading in the OB area. No numeric speed/displacement threshold is specified.
Breaker belongs to structure context and forms with a new HH/LL / structure break-update relationship.
Higher-priority Методичка explicitly requires Breaker penetration with imbalance followed by CHOCH/structure shift. Stage 4 therefore requires IMB plus a causal structure-shift reference.
Low-side raid maps to LONG OB and high-side raid maps to SHORT OB as deterministic directional mirror.
The qualitative phrase that the impulse overlaps/engulfs the candidate is represented by directional impulse-body coverage of the candidate body; no ATR/body-ratio threshold is added.
Qualitative aggressive-impulse and large-body/small-wick facts require an auditable evidence id and causal known_at.
Machine representation of a broken OB requires a completed candle body close beyond the opposite edge of the parent OB zone; wick-only penetration is not auto-promoted.
Fast impulse and continuous/no-trading-through-OB claims require auditable qualitative evidence; no hidden numeric threshold is permitted.

forbidden_as_source: ATR displacement threshold for aggressive/fast impulse
fixed OB timeframe mapping such as 240/60
post-hoc future reaction as historical object validity
